scope: Fresh live Controller source executed in an isolated fixture with native GUI objects and mocked player/input/remote services. No Play test was started by this agent.
checks: Mouse physical-screen position converts once into device-safe viewport coordinates; crosshair and ray use the same point.
Touch, gamepad and locked mouse aim through camera centre.
Phone, portrait phone, tablet and desktop headers fit nine safe viewport sizes without runtime size or position rewrites.
Fire and Sprint stay on the right, have at least 44px targets, do not overlap and clear the lower jump-control area.
Red HeatGun and blue MudGun send Fire camera-ray requests; Heat and palette controls are removed.
Mouse first shot, held repeat, release, R2 input, local and server cooldowns.
Native Humanoid locally re-equips its enabled assigned Backpack gun before shooting; stale-round, wrong-owner, wrong-team, unmanaged and disabled tools are rejected.
Touch camera pan, sprint touch and processed GUI clicks do not shoot.
Settings, admin, Roblox menu, text focus and lost window focus block shooting.
Three lives, lost-heart colouring, OUT state, countdown and tied results.
UIHidden suppresses the header but retains essential touch actions.
Round exit and script destruction unbind actions and render callbacks.
